_comment: cloud-ci-authz-coverage gate policy (issue #770; AUTH-005 pipeline-as-product backstop). R0 pack-shaped DATA — all repo-specifics live here, the Rust engine is neutral. Surface DISCOVERY is anchored on the ROUTE-INTRODUCTION call set (`.route(` / `.route_service(`) — NOT on a `Router::new()` constructor — so a Router::default()/Router::<S>::new()/aliased-binding/Router-parameter/builder-returned router, and a route declared after `.with_state(...)` or in a helper fn, are all discovered (PR #780 second-pass BLOCKER-1/2/3). Two route grammars are classified: axum `.route(path, METHOD(handler))` and the owned http-router-kernel `.route(HttpMethod::X, path, handler)`. The owned-kernel handler argument may be a bare handler or the repo-owned `handler_to_sync(HandlerStruct)` bridge; the engine unwraps that bridge and inspects the typed Handler impl body, not the bridge call itself. A control-plane surface (mutating method or per-resource path param) requires fail-closed authz: a router-level auth layer (auth_layer_idents, whole-token match) OR every mutating handler invoking a recognized authz guard (authz_guard_idents, whole-token + call-shape match). /healthz-style reads are exempt via exempt_path_substrings. Anything the engine cannot fully classify — an unresolved path, an unclassified method-router, a structurally-unclassifiable route call, or an unresolved .merge/.nest sub-router — fails CLOSED (AC-UNRESOLVED-ROUTE-PATH / AC-UNCLASSIFIED-METHOD / AC-UNCLASSIFIED-SURFACE / AC-UNRESOLVED-SUBROUTER), never silently skipped. Ratchets vs frozen_unauthenticated_surfaces (today's known surfaces) so the gate lands green and only NEW unauthenticated control planes block. The remediation doctrine is intelligence/adapters/rest + tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app.
_frozen_baseline_note: Pre-existing unauthenticated / unprovable HTTP control-plane surfaces, FROZEN and re-keyed by stable scope+signature (`<file>#<scope>::router[<sorted (method, route-path) tuples>]`) after the PR #780 fail-closed surface-discovery repair. Each key in frozen_unauthenticated_surfaces is pre-existing debt owned by its capability team; the baseline is SHRINK-ONLY and `--write` may drop fixed/removed keys without `--allow-new`, while new live unauthenticated keys remain blocking. Tenant RBAC is no longer classified as zero-authz debt: the engine mechanically resolves owned http-router-kernel `handler_to_sync(HandlerStruct)` route handlers to their typed Handler impls and can see the fail-closed tenant/body guard while the runtime path still requires verified principal + PBAC (RBAC + ABAC) PDP authorization. Provider-pool is no longer classified as zero-authz debt after PR #1009 replaced dynamic mount routing with literal protected handlers carrying require_data_plane_bearer/require_bearer PBAC decisions. Remaining frozen keys in this policy are the exact listed unresolved or unauthenticated surfaces: console workspace shell reads, iac module registry assembly, identity-service SCIM unresolved formatted routes, intelligence compatibility APIs, and the unresolved shared backbone route loop. iam/ports/policy-cedar-api publish_handler and oya/ci-webhook-gateway POST /webhook/github are GREEN via fail-closed verification. SCAN-ROOTS WIDENING (chore/authz-coverage-scan-roots-widen): scan_roots was widened from 10 to 20 and then to the full 30-root crate-bearing set the sibling cloud-ci-dto-authz-trust gate already scans (added audit, cell, compliance, compute, data, network, observability, secrets, storage, workflow), closing the fail-open where a new unauthenticated HTTP control plane in any of those roots passed silently. Remediation per surface: see the doctrine in intelligence/adapters/rest + tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app.

product_contract.born_blocking: Born-blocking vs a frozen baseline of currently-known unauthenticated surfaces. The two reference surfaces (intelligence/adapters/rest, tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app) are GREEN by construction (they carry authz). Pre-existing unauthenticated surfaces are frozen in frozen_unauthenticated_surfaces (shrink-only). Only a NEW unauthenticated control plane blocks.
product_contract.pack_shaped: Neutral engine; every repo-specific is DATA in this file. A different repo adopts the gate by repointing the policy.
product_contract.fail_closed: No shell/network/VCS. A read-only walk of the candidate tree's Rust source. Malformed policy, gate-id mismatch, and a below-floor surface census all fail closed.
product_contract.remediation_doctrine: intelligence/adapters/rest/src/lib.rs (admin_tenant_allowed + PDP gate.decide + constant_time_eq) and tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app/src/lib.rs (authenticate_caller + authorize() per route).
